claim: The audit uses four separate components: path availability, path effort, transparency, and choice effectiveness.
claim_boundary: The project does not collapse these components into one scalar privacy score.

claim: A direction label requires dated comparable states and component evidence; a raw DOM image or copy difference is not enough.
claim_boundary: Direction and causal explanation are graded separately.

claim: The controlled package contains 42 audit reports and 20 longitudinal summaries.
claim_boundary: These are package rows and not 62 independent sites or time points.

claim: All five matched local site reviews remain insufficient evidence for directional change.
offline_evidence: 10 matched baseline/follow-up layer1 PNGs; 365 tracked capture PNGs
claim_boundary: The local lane validates capture and comparison discipline; it does not establish improvement or regression.

claim: Google reduced rejection effort from at least five actions to a one-click first-layer Reject all choice.
evidence_basis: RET-01; regulator before state plus company after announcement
offline_evidence: S01 and S02 source locator cards
claim_boundary: Direction is moderate because the after state is a company rollout announcement.

claim: Facebook deployed refusal with simplicity equivalent to acceptance and CNIL later closed the injunction.
evidence_basis: RET-02; regulator before and follow-up records
offline_evidence: S03 and S04 source locator cards
claim_boundary: The record verifies the refusal mechanism and order response; it is not a full audit of every tracker.

claim: TikTok added a first-layer Tout refuser button while purpose information remained deficient.
evidence_basis: RET-03; one regulator decision records both states
claim_boundary: This is an effort improvement and not complete consent-system compliance.

claim: Orange stopped relevant cookie reads and writes on orange.fr after withdrawal and CNIL closed the order.
claim_boundary: Third-party cookies could remain in the browser and activity outside orange.fr was outside the recorded remedy.

claim: Vanity Fair later showed ineffective refusal or withdrawal after an earlier proceeding had closed.
claim_boundary: Choice effectiveness regressed; transparency direction is not assessed and the cause is unknown.

claim: SHEIN remediated refusal and withdrawal behavior during regulatory proceedings.
offline_evidence: S12 source locator card and archived official PDF
claim_boundary: The public decision does not provide the exact deployment date or prove the proceeding was the sole cause.

claim: Five of six purposively selected cases improved at least one component and one functionally regressed.
claim_boundary: This case-series fraction is not a web-wide prevalence estimate.

claim: All three first-layer cases reduced acceptance-favoring rejection asymmetry.
claim_boundary: The result concerns path availability and effort; it does not imply complete informed consent.

claim: Concrete interactions that regulators can specify and verify show the clearest documented improvement.
evidence_basis: Pattern synthesis across six cases and separate causal-evidence grades
offline_evidence: Case table; source cards; archived S12 decision
claim_boundary: This is an observational interpretation and not a universal causal estimate.

claim: A separate historical study reports 11364 websites across 30 countries and growth in first-layer Accept-and-Reject availability from 2.94 percent in 2018 to 30.66 percent in 2024.
evidence_basis: Dimova et al. 2026 abstract and sections 3.3.6 and 7
claim_boundary: This preprint is an external benchmark and not part of the six-company sample.
